master.note: Built locally, NOT by the firmware team's release toolchain. Hardware-validated on two leader units (TCGU01A28Z0023m / 0024m): version reports 1.2.3.0, encoder and IMU both read (accel magnitude 9.72 / 9.64 m/s^2 at rest), the data stream holds ~100 Hz over 2 s, and an unassigned command code answers ProtocolError(NACK: InvalidCmd) -- that last one is the point, because it proves the V2.3 error semantics reached the leader. Key handling carries an upstream change (823e351, timing constants) validated separately. 1.2.3 is where the leader and follower version lines merge: they share protocol_handler.c, so a shared-layer change obliges both, and separate lines made it easy to bump one and forget the other. POWER-CYCLE THE GRIPPER AFTER FLASHING.

slave.note: Built locally, NOT by the firmware team's release toolchain. Hardware-validated on two follower units (TCGU01A28Z0018s / 0015s): auto-calibration completes, force-position control reaches 1.000 / 0.001 / 1.000 with arrived=True, the idle status stream stays fresh (status_timestamp_ms advances ~2000 ms over a 2 s idle window -- it used to freeze), and instruction-5 fault reads keep advancing. Power-on calibration is 11 s -> 1.3 s (two-stage approach), repeatability 0.77 mrad over five power cycles against a 29 mrad open-limit margin. POWER-CYCLE THE GRIPPER AFTER FLASHING (24 V, not just USB).
